headline: Local-first video, reviewed fast.
oneRule: KeepPeek ingests events; it does not own detection.

evidence.contains: KeepPeek is a local-first network video recorder (NVR) and Media Gateway for IP cameras.
KeepPeek is currently a proof of concept (POC) and is not yet production-ready.
Recording, playback, review, and administration all work with no vendor cloud.
KeepPeek deliberately does not own detection.

PTZ is a control-channel command, not a media subscription and not an HTTP route.

blockers: Current persistence stores one mutable event row and one thumbnail rather than revision and attachment history.
The browser RecordingEvent adapter does not yet expose wire text, payload, revision, source_id, or multiple attachments.

principles.name: Test before save
blockers: The final write boundary is enforced, but candidate authentication and decoded stream probing are unavailable before save.

constraints: Core NVR operation has no vendor-cloud or relay dependency.
Application controls use binary protobuf over negotiated WebRTC data channels.
HTTP is limited to session create/delete, logs, metrics, and the protobuf-defined backup recovery API.
Missing event evidence is labelled unavailable and is never synthesized.
No product surface may imply production readiness, customers, benchmarks, pricing, or uptime claims.
